{"initial_observation":{"company":"CLOSE_fin_04","message":"The ledger is accessed through the supplied SQL tools.","storage_note":"Pandas materializes recorded_at as SQLite YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS timestamps. Compare timestamps semantically, for example datetime(recorded_at)<=datetime(cutoff). Raw lexical comparison with a T-separated cutoff changes same-day ordering."},"max_actions":10,"task":"Company CLOSE_fin_04 keeps a single heterogeneous ledger table. Every record type is stored in ledger, so SQL self-joins and CTEs can be used. Close the payable ledger as it was known at recorded_at <= 2026-10-24T12:00:00, for business_date <= 2026-10-23. All timestamps are UTC ISO text. Start by excluding rows with future business dates and rows recorded late, then keep only the highest revision for each (kind,event_key). If that latest row has status void, the key is removed entirely; never fall back to an older row. Invoice rows use event_key as the invoice ID; payment, credit and hold rows use invoice_id to point to their parent invoice. Keep the active invoices for vendor BLUE with due_date <= 2026-10-30. Payments and credits reduce the gross amount_minor, in the invoice currency. Active holds reduce the remaining amount; holds with status release or void do not. Clamp as follows: remaining=max(0,gross-sum(payments)-sum(credits)), then unheld=max(0,remaining-sum(active holds)). For each invoice, pick the active terms row that has the same terms_code and the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date (applying the same revision and as-of filtering). The discounted amount is unheld * (10000-discount_bps)/10000 only when 2026-10-23 <= discount_until; otherwise it is unheld. Next, pick the active FX row for that invoice's currency with the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date. Convert to USD cents using fx_num/fx_den. Round only this final per-invoice amount to the nearest cent, rounding exact halves up. Sum the rounded per-invoice USD cents. Invoices in USD also have FX rows. Do not net invoices together before rounding. Submit only the integer number of USD cents.","task_id":"fin-04","tools":[{"description":"Get a list of available table names for a company.","name":"get_descriptions","parameters":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"company_name":{"description":"The name of the company","type":"string"}},"required":["company_name"],"type":"object"}},{"description":"Get table metadata: description, columns, types, unique values.","name":"get_table_info","parameters":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"company_name":{"description":"The name of the company","type":"string"},"table_name":{"description":"The name of the table","type":"string"}},"required":["company_name","table_name"],"type":"object"}},{"description":"Execute a SQL query on a table.
